Treatment summary
Patient presented following a collision in which the patient's vehicle was struck from
the side while the patient was making a left turn. Diagnosis: lumbar strain. The
mechanism and force of impact are consistent with the soft tissue injury reported.
Initial evaluation documented paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced lumbar range of
motion, with neurological screening within normal limits. Treatment consisted of 25
visits over the course of care, including manual therapy, graded therapeutic exercise,
and home exercise instruction. Symptoms improved steadily, and visit frequency was
reduced in line with the expected recovery pattern. The patient has a remote history of
a minor strain involving the same region, which resolved completely without residual
limitation before this event. Billed services reflect the treatment plan, with no
duplicate or repeated charges identified in the record. At discharge the patient had
met functional goals, with residual stiffness only with prolonged sitting. Prognosis
is good with continued self-directed exercise.

  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
